title: Cost-Efficient Large Language Model Serving for Multi-turn Conversations with CachedAttention
authors: Bin Gao; Zhuomin He; Puru Sharma; Qingxuan Kang; Djordje Jevdjic; Junbo Deng; Xingkun Yang; Zhou Yu; Pengfei Zuo
affiliations: National University of Singapore, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Huawei Cloud
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache offloading, GPU memory tiering, Multi-tenant scheduling

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving engines repeatedly recompute the KV caches of historical tokens across multi-turn conversations, because KV caches are discarded to free HBM when a session becomes inactive and must be regenerated when it resumes. This repetitive prefill dominates cost (up to 99% of prefilling) and inflates serving cost and TTFT as conversations grow.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務引擎在多輪對話中會重複計算歷史 token 的 KV cache：當 session 進入非活躍狀態時，KV cache 會被丟棄以釋放 HBM，待對話再度活躍時又須重新 prefill。此重複計算最高佔 prefilling 成本的 99%，並使 serving 成本與 TTFT 隨對話輪數增加而上升。

key_innovation.en: CachedAttention, an attention mechanism that reuses KV caches across conversation turns via a hierarchical KV caching system (AttentionStore) spanning HBM, host DRAM, and disks. It employs layer-wise pre-loading and asynchronous saving to overlap slow-medium KV access with GPU computation, scheduler-aware fetching and eviction to keep hot KV caches in the fastest tier, and positional-encoding-decoupled truncation to keep saved KV caches valid after context-window overflow.
key_innovation.zh: 提出 CachedAttention：一種可跨對話輪次重用 KV cache 的 attention 機制，並搭配橫跨 HBM、host DRAM 與 disk 的階層式 KV caching 系統 AttentionStore。其以 layer-wise 預載入與非同步儲存，將慢速媒介的 KV 存取與 GPU 運算重疊；以 scheduler-aware 的 fetching 與 eviction 將熱門 KV cache 保留於最快層；並藉由解耦 positional encoding 的截斷機制，使 KV cache 在 context window 溢位後仍然有效。

key_improvements.en: Reduces TTFT by up to 87% and improves prompt prefilling throughput by up to 7.8x for multi-turn conversations; lowers end-to-end inference cost by up to 70%. Achieves up to 86% KV cache hit rate and up to 2.7x GPU-time speedup over LRU/FIFO eviction.
key_improvements.zh: 在多輪對話中將 TTFT 最多降低 87%、prompt prefilling 吞吐量最多提升 7.8x；端到端推理成本最多降低 70%。KV cache hit rate 最高達 86%，相較 LRU/FIFO eviction，GPU 時間最多加速 2.7x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
